news.title: Gold's haven status has lost its edge over bitcoin, and the Fed's to blame
news.summary: Gold has lost the risk-adjusted advantage that made it this year's haven of choice over bitcoin. Both now offer negative one-year Sharpe ratios, leaving cash yields hard to beat.

news.title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
news.summary: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.

news.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
news.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

news.title: South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb warns of phishing after deeper October breach probe
news.summary: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange said its trading systems were not breached, but stolen customer records could already be being used in future scams.

news.title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million
news.summary: Lawmaker Yaroslav Zhelezniak said he expects roughly $330 million (15 billion hryvnias) in added budget revenue, though the time frame remains unclear.

news.title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
news.summary: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

news.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
news.summary: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

news.title: French Senate blocks new crypto tax and wallet list critics called a kidnapping risk
news.summary: The government opposed the measures citing existing EU data-sharing rules and non-legal tender status, leaving the 2027 budget open.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
